  SELECT
    r."XCL_075" AS driver_id,
    (CAST(SUBSTRING(r."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
    + (CAST(SUBSTRING(r."XCL_088", INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') + 1, INSTR(r."XCL_088", '.') - INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL))

  INNER JOIN races AS ra ON r."XCL_074" = ra."XCL_065"
  INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON ra."XCL_068" = c."XCL_001"
  WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Italy'
    AND r."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  d."XCL_038",
  d."XCL_039"
FROM italian_fastest_laps AS f
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON f.driver_id = d."XCL_034"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
ORDER BY f.time_in_seconds ASC
LIMIT 1
